excluded.swing_sequence: Unavailable: no unambiguous direction-normalized mapping was preregistered.
excluded.alignment_score: No Discriminative Information check only: BASELINE trend setup creates mostly fixed values.

feature_explanations.pullback_to_impulse: Retracement size relative to the preceding confirmed structural impulse.
feature_explanations.impulse_atr: Confirmed impulse amplitude normalized by pre-entry 15m ATR.
feature_explanations.impulse_efficiency: Directional cleanliness of the prior impulse path.
feature_explanations.pullback_atr: Maximum adverse pullback from impulse endpoint in ATR units.
feature_explanations.pullback_bars: Completed 15m bars elapsed from impulse endpoint to entry decision.
feature_explanations.pullback_time_ratio: Pullback duration divided by impulse duration.
feature_explanations.recovery_fraction: Recovery from pullback extreme by confirmation close.
feature_explanations.structure_room_r: Distance to last confirmed direction-side swing expressed in initial R.
feature_explanations.stop_distance_atr: Initial Swing stop distance in pre-entry ATR units.
feature_explanations.ema_distance_15m: Direction-standardized EMA20/EMA50 distance on completed 15m data.
feature_explanations.ema_distance_1h: Direction-standardized EMA20/EMA50 distance on completed 1H data.
feature_explanations.ema_distance_4h: Direction-standardized EMA20/EMA50 distance on completed 4H data.
feature_explanations.return_3bar_atr: Direction-standardized completed three-bar return in ATR units.
feature_explanations.return_5bar_atr: Direction-standardized completed five-bar return in ATR units.
feature_explanations.atr_ratio_15m: Completed ATR relative to its prior 100-bar median.
feature_explanations.range_compression_5: Last five completed ranges divided by prior 20 completed ranges.
